note: Category E (tools 201-250) contains zero calculator tools. All 50 tools are generators, planners, builders, checkers, trackers, or scorers driven by template engines, rule engines, checklists, canvas rendering, or localStorage state. No numeric formulas with verifiable external values exist in this category, so this registry is intentionally empty rather than padded with invented math. If a future tool in this category performs fee/revenue math, it gets a per-tool record under data/formulas/<slug>.v1.json per the registry README.
